description: This file defines the ThreadSnapshot class, representing a snapshot of a thread within a VM trace, including thread attributes, stack frames, mutexes, and binder call information.

classes.name: ThreadSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of a thread's state, including thread attributes, stack frames, mutexes, and binder call data, with comparison and copying capabilities.

methods.name: ThreadSnapshot
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes an empty ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: ThreadSnapshot
methods.description: Copy constructor, creates a deep copy of the given ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of this ThreadSnapshot.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ThreadSnapshot with another based on thread ID and system thread ID.

methods.name: isBinder
methods.description: Returns true if the thread has any binder call data (either inbound or outbound).
